title: Keep work and progress note when producer hits deadline; resume on retry
summary: When the producer stage hits its deadline, keep the job's worktree edits and write a progress note listing changed files. Record the job as timed out, not failed. Make `athena retry` resume from the kept work with the note, and make status show timed out versus failed. Producer stage only; the audience is the Athena operator who loses 20-30 minutes per timeout.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria require cargo test, clippy, fmt to pass.
Criteria check worktree edits, note, and recorded outcome in tests.
Behavior criteria name cargo commands the verifier can run.
Only the first step: keep and resume.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Scope is producer stage only, per the user's replies: no verifier-stage timeouts, no planning split, no deadline length change.
Existing record formats must stay readable.
Deliverable paths are carried over from the earlier attempt and not re-verified in the repository.

acceptance_criteria.text: A test with the fake agent exceeds a short producer deadline after editing files. Afterwards the edits remain in the job worktree, a progress note listing the changed files exists, and the job is recorded as timed out, not failed. Run: cargo test.
A test retries a timed-out job. The new producer starts from the kept worktree (not a clean checkout) and is given the progress note naming the earlier changed files. Run: cargo test.
Status output distinguishes a timed-out job from a failed one, and the deadline reason (e.g. 'deadline of 1800s reached') is kept in the record. Run: cargo test.
A test shows existing records with killed or failed outcomes still deserialize unchanged, and a job that finishes in time behaves as before. Run: cargo test.
The new timed-out outcome is documented and CHANGELOG.md mentions the change.
cargo test, cargo clippy and cargo fmt --check all pass with no new warnings. Run each.

departures: The earlier attempt hit the 1800s deadline on this same scope, so cost, time and verification pass rate are shifted toward harder than the reference.
urgent_reason: Cuts redo-work retries: a producer timeout currently discards 20-30 minutes of work and forces a restart from scratch.
